Thus it happens that, after the manner of Atalanta, they turn aside from the path to pick up the golden apple; meanwhile, they interrupt their course and let the victory slip from their hands. But in the true course of Experience, and in producing new works from it, Divine Wisdom and Order must be taken as the model. For God, on the first day of Creation, created only Light, and assigned an entire day to that work; nor did He create any material work on that day. In the same way, from Experience of every kind, the discovery of true Causes and Axioms must first be drawn out: and light-bearing <note>original: "lucifera"</note> Experiments, not fruit-bearing <note>original: "fructifera"</note> ones, must be sought. For Axioms rightly discovered and established provide for Practice not narrowly, but in abundance; and they draw behind them ranks and troops of Works. But concerning the methods of experimenting, which are no less blocked and closed off than the methods of Judging, we shall speak later: for the present we have spoken only of common Experience as a bad form of Demonstration. Now the order of things requires that we add something concerning those signs, which we mentioned a little while ago, (showing that the Philosophies and Contemplations in use are in a bad state;) and concerning the Causes of a thing so wonderful and incredible at first sight. For the knowledge of the signs prepares the way for assent: while the explanation of the Causes removes the wonder. These two things help greatly toward a more easy and gentle extirpation of the Idols <note>Bacon's term for the false images and prejudices that obstruct human understanding</note> from the Intellect.

<summary>Bacon argues that researchers should prioritize light-bearing experiments over immediate practical results, following the divine model of creation. He transitions to discussing signs of the current philosophy's failure and the causes behind its poor state.</summary>
<keywords>Atalanta, light-bearing experiments, fruit-bearing experiments, divine order, axioms, practice, idols of the mind, demonstration</keywords>
